Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a safety-tier review. The change affects posted G-code.

- The post refuses a positive G73 dwell by name before cycle positioning and output.
- The post keeps zero-dwell G73 output and the verified G83 dwell output.
- The change follows the maintainer's decision on #2354.
- No golden file changed. No UI, dependency, build script, or process file changed.

I ran all checks locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2376`.
The trial merge with `upstream/main` at `6349a542e7560510a830bfb5521cefdd13e6b2e6` needed no changes.
The PR head already contains that main commit.
I disabled the inherited sccache wrapper for these checks.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed all 44 steps.
The gate built the selected post and app test binaries with `--no-run`.

`cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

I ran two mutation checks:

1. I restored the old CPS from upstream main. `sinumerik_g73_dwell_is_refused_by_name` failed at 0.001 s with no warning.
2. I changed the G73 guard from `p.P > 0` to `p.P >= 0`. `sinumerik_g73_without_dwell_still_posts` failed because the post refused zero dwell.

Both G73 tests passed after each restoration. The worktree has no source changes.

Requested changes: none.

No physical control test was done. This review does not verify G73 P support.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
